sql:
SELECT DISTINCT d.type 
FROM disp d 
JOIN account a ON d.account_id = a.account_id 
JOIN district dis ON a.district_id = dis.district_id 
WHERE dis.A11 > 8000 AND dis.A11 <= 9000 AND NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM loan l WHERE l.account_id = a.account_id
)
